# IPSM Approach

> IPSM Approach (Integrated Pronunciation, Spelling and Meaning) is a unified method for memorizing English vocabulary by bringing sound, form, and meaning together. Hosted at https://lingose.com in 10 languages (English at the site root, plus zh / es / fr / de / vi / ru / ja / ko / ar).

IPSM unifies three perspectives that are usually taught separately:

- **IPS (Integrated Pronunciation & Spelling)**: phoneme-annotation marks embedded in the word so the spelling itself encodes how it sounds.
- **ISM (Integrated Spelling & Meaning)**: morpheme segmentation that makes word-formation rules and the meaning-carrying structure visible in the spelling.
- **IPM (Integrated Pronunciation & Meaning)**: the inner link between a word's phoneme rhythm and its meaning.
